event.canonical_title: Luigi Mangione Expected to Plead Guilty in Case Involving CEO's Death
event.summary: Luigi Mangione is anticipated to plead guilty in federal court to charges related to the stalking and killing of UnitedHealthcare CEO Brian Thompson. The hearing is set for today, and discussions about a potential plea deal are ongoing. Mangione faces significant penalties, including life imprisonment, if he is found guilty on federal charges, which may also impact his state murder charges due to double jeopardy concerns.

timeline.title: Luigi Mangione Admits Guilt in Killing of UnitedHealthcare CEO
timeline.summary: Luigi Mangione has pleaded guilty to federal charges related to the killing of UnitedHealthcare CEO Brian Thompson, admitting to stalking and fatally shooting him in December 2024. Mangione, who used a 3-D printed gun with a silencer, faces a potential life sentence at his upcoming sentencing in December. He is also contending with separate state murder charges in New York, which his lawyers are seeking to dismiss based on double jeopardy protections.

timeline.title: Luigi Mangione's State Murder Trial Delayed Amid Double Jeopardy Claims
timeline.summary: Luigi Mangione's state murder trial has been postponed following his guilty plea to federal charges related to the 2024 killing of UnitedHealthcare CEO Brian Thompson. His attorneys argued that pursuing state charges would constitute double jeopardy, prompting a request for dismissal of the state case. The trial was effectively adjourned as a result.

event_overview.title: About CEO Murder Case
event_overview.subject: CEO Murder Case
event_overview.summary: The CEO Murder Case concerns the December 4, 2024 killing of UnitedHealthcare Chief Executive Officer Brian Thompson in Midtown Manhattan and the criminal proceedings against Luigi Mangione. The case includes a federal prosecution in the Southern District of New York and a separate New York State prosecution arising from the same death.

facts.label: Incident
facts.value: Brian Thompson was killed on December 4, 2024, near West 54th Street and Sixth Avenue in Midtown Manhattan, while traveling to UnitedHealthcare's investor conference.

facts.label: State case
facts.value: New York County's separate indictment charges first-degree murder, second-degree murder including terrorism-related counts, weapons-possession offenses, and possession of a forged instrument; the state proceeding is separate from the federal case.

event_overview.scope_note: This timeline follows major developments in the criminal proceedings connected to Thompson's killing, including the federal plea, but does not attempt to catalog every filing, hearing, evidentiary dispute, or related public reaction.
